약점을 숨기는 대신 배울 지점으로 삼아 볼 수 있다.

Emerson argues that defeat can expose ignorance and make learning possible.

### A present-day example · editorial commentary

After being unable to answer a presentation question, identify the particular premise you could not explain rather than conclude “I am incapable.” Checking that point and trying the explanation again can make learning possible. A weakness can become a point of inquiry rather than concealment.

### Reflect

What limit has this difficulty revealed?

### Keep in mind

Suffering does not necessarily produce growth.

This need not glorify suffering or justify refusing help.
